groups.name: screen_identity_and_registration
groups.base_provenance: on_enter preserves incoming screen pointer in RDI, logs MenuScreenLoadout, calls initializer with same pointer, and registers that exact pointer with tag E5 in global 3326E68. Includes list count +62E8 used by B90040.

groups.name: allocation_and_four_element_construction
groups.base_provenance: Allocator-like call receives size 2739D0; returned memory is zeroed for that size, constructed by 14A17E0, stored at screen-manager +B0. Constructor loops four times at +53A78 stride 1EE18. Exact name of allocator is unproven.

groups.name: mapping_reset_and_local_slot_zero
groups.base_provenance: Initializer has same screen in RDI. Two adjacent 4-DWORD maps reset to FFFFFFFF. Finds local peer ID in owner client records, reads network index, sets forward[index]=0 and inverse[0]=index; no local index<4 check in this sequence.

groups.name: network_index_to_loadout_slot_consumer
groups.base_provenance: Tag-E5 registered pointer, peer ID lookup in client owner, then forward map value<4 gates UI subobject at +620E8 + slot*1EE18. Slot is not roster ordinal.

groups.name: mapping_assignment_during_roster_update
groups.base_provenance: Screen in RSI. Reads separate roster pointer-list ordinal, explicitly checks ordinal<4, derives peer identity and then network index through owner client. Reserves UI slot zero; searches inverse slots 1..3 for FFFFFFFF, then writes both maps.

groups.name: mapping_assignment_registered_event
groups.base_provenance: Another tag-E5 subscriber reads screen+27D4, bounds that network index<4, and fills inverse slot1..3 before using whole per-slot widget at +53A78.

groups.name: four_slot_release_and_transition
groups.base_provenance: Screen update scans inverse map and paired widgets exactly four times, clears forward[networkIndex] and inverse[slot]. Separate transition hides/updates four widgets. Does not prove destructor coverage.

groups.name: subobject_ui_behavior
groups.base_provenance: 1893D40 writes selected value to widget+3C4, searches a 21-entry table, and uses UI functions at 1448690 / 144F800 on widget+110. Exact user-facing selection name is unresolved.

groups.name: separate_network_index_records_in_same_screen
groups.base_provenance: The screen also has four records at +10 with stride 9F0 ending at +27D0. Constructor initializes four. 146FC40 resolves a roster peer to its network index, gates index<4, then copies 9F0 bytes to the indexed record. This index is deliberately distinct from the forward-map display slot.

limits: Screen display/loadout slots are distinct from network indices and gameplay roster ordinals.
These are code/data layout facts, not an observed execution or successful eight-player mod.
Selected anchors and field scans are not a complete relocation inventory or destructor audit.
The allocator-like indirect target and exact selection represented by 1893D40 are unnamed.
Only captured code/read-only/unwind are read; writable objects and live process are not queried.
